facts: Current canonical inventory is 169: 100 production-active questions plus 18 Rules drafts, 23 Risk verified drafts, and 28 Systems verified drafts.

The current 100-question released seed bank contains 26 Rules, 29 Systems, 22 Operations, and 23 Risk questions; the three completed expansion batches add only Rules (+18), Risk (+23), and Systems (+28).
Operations therefore remains the thinnest canonical domain at 22 questions while Rules=44, Risk=46, and Systems=57.
B2 Risk and B3 Systems source-verification gates are complete; B1 Rules drafts remain prerelease and Rules R5 remains source-limited/STOP under the existing contract.
Production active/released/runtime remains 100/100/100; no expansion draft has been activated by this review.
The adopted 180-220 figure is a coverage exploration envelope, not a release quota or an approved final Production target.
rationale: Stopping at 169 would leave a pronounced domain imbalance: Operations has 22 canonical questions versus 44-57 in every other domain.
The established expansion order is Risk -> Systems -> Operations -> Rules targeted-only, so Operations is the next contract-consistent domain after verified B3 Systems evidence.
A fixed final Production target is not yet defensible because the useful Operations source ceiling has not been measured through a source-first B4 authoring/review pass.
B4 must retain only explicit, second-class-applicable, semantically distinct propositions; candidate count is an observed result, not a quota designed to reach 180, 200, or 220.

source_ceiling_notes.operations_source_area: MLIT-UAS-SAFETY-GUIDE-5 Chapter 5, with adjacent general second-class operational requirements where directly relevant
source_ceiling_notes.known_existing_coverage: The released seed already covers representative preflight checks, manual/automatic transitions, fatigue/stress/alcohol, TEM/CRM, helper coordination, security, accident response, and selected operational procedures.
source_ceiling_notes.authoring_rule: Search the official source first for explicit answer-defining propositions not already represented in the 169-question canonical inventory; exclude explicitly first-class-only material, weak paraphrase variants, and semantic collisions.
source_ceiling_notes.stop_rule: Stop B4 authoring when additional Operations ideas require inference beyond the official source or collapse into existing propositions; do not force-fill to an envelope.

next_review_trigger: Review target/coverage again after the B4 Operations accepted set has completed independent review and source-ceiling evidence is known, and no later than the point at which integrated canonical inventory materially enters the 180-220 exploration envelope.
inference: Given the current 22-question Operations inventory and the breadth of general Chapter 5 operational material, a useful B4 set is likely available, but its size is intentionally not predetermined.
The final Production target should remain unresolved until B4 demonstrates how much non-duplicative second-class Operations coverage the source actually supports.
